description: Show the unavailable banquet-fruit item in gray outside its quest stage; preserve active purchase conditions, all currency math, flags and saves

edits.old: IF active[$event['Akabur_quest']] = 11 and gold < 1000 and sparks < 10000 or fruits_maxibox = 1: FUNC('$menu', 'location_gray', $menu_item_balsam_gray, empty, '연회용 과일 (1000)')
edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START AGRABAH_FRUIT_DISABLED_MENU_20261030
IF active[$event['Akabur_quest']] ! 11 or (gold < 1000 and sparks < 10000) or fruits_maxibox = 1: FUNC('$menu', 'location_gray', $menu_item_balsam_gray, empty, '연회용 과일 (1000)')
! JO9 MOD END AGRABAH_FRUIT_DISABLED_MENU_20261030
